mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in > 60% of triggered instances over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in > 60% of triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in > 60% of triggered instances over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month does not lead to a statistically significant positive return in > 60% of triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to a statistically significant positive return in > 60% of instances over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month does not lead to a statistically significant positive return in > 60% of triggered instances over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% YoY
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% YoY does not lead to a statistically significant positive return in > 60% of triggered instances over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals tightening financial conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in a tightening cycle does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in > 60% of triggered instances over a 5-year period.
